avg_energy_above_hull_per_atom.description: Average energy above hull per atom (eV/atom) of structures in sampled data.

frac_stable_structures.description: Fraction of stable structures in sampled data within 0.1 (eV/atom) above convex hull of alex-mp MP2020 correction.

frac_novel_unique_stable_structures.description: Fraction of novel unique stable structures in sampled data within 0.1 (eV/atom) above convex hull of alex-mp MP2020 correction.

frac_novel_structures.description: Fraction of novel structures in sampled data.

frac_unique_structures.description: Fraction of unique structures in sampled data.

avg_rmsd_from_relaxation.description: root mean square displacements of atoms (Angstrom) from initial to final DFT relaxation steps in sampled data.
